ITEM 1 | Roasted or pan-fried cubed pieces, roughly 2-3 cm chunks, golden-brown to dark brown with charred edges and darker purple-black skin patches, slightly glossy and oily surface, cut irregular faces, piled in a mound on the left half of the plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Single whole pale cream-colored piece, about 3 cm across, smooth matte rounded surface with a slightly browned spot, sitting on top of the cubed pieces at the upper left of the mound | 25
ITEM 3 | Fresh mixed salad greens, mostly bright green and dark red-purple leaves with ruffled edges, some pale frilly leaves at the top right, slightly wet with a light sheen, covering roughly the right third of the plate, leaves about 5-12 cm long | 60
ITEM 4 | Small amount of brown sauce or dressing residue smeared on the plate near the cubed pieces and along the mound's edge, thin film, matte to slightly glossy | 5
ITEM 5 | Small sprig of green leafy herb or lettuce fragment, bright green and frilly, about 2 cm, lying on the adjacent plate at the left edge | 2
